scope: Source-led audit of EC3 issues #18,#38,#39,#50,#91,#145,#150,#153,#179,#222,#283,#327,#331,#362,#389,#402,#415,#425,#563,#645,#687,#690,#699. results.ledger_and_assertions: §13.2.4.2 immediately below separately says the data MH/BE BU entry is Table 287, and Table 287 defines BU; Table 289 defines section B/E offsets. `media.rs::clip_data` follows Table 287 for data BU. `media_viability.rs::a_section_is_viable_with_its_next_level_clip_and_a_must_honour_offset_is_not` and related controls cover section offsets but no direct data-BU assertion was found.

results.source: §7.3.3 EBNF attachments, EC3 appended errata sheet at physical PDF page 1004 (no ISO printed footer)
results.change: Adds two FileAttachment EBNF text files, PDF-Integer.ebnf and PDF-Real.ebnf. Parent extracted and read the actual 79/124-byte attachments; they are textual grammar definitions, not merely page figures.
results.ledger_and_assertions: Integer grammar requires optional sign and at least one digit. Real grammar requires optional sign and a decimal point with digits on at least one side. This agrees with fixed-format source forms. Reader acceptance of exponents is a separately documented tolerance (ADR0733), not evidence of strict writer syntax.
results.verdict: No reader rejection test warranted from this writer-side grammar; the diagrams state the permitted number forms.
